title: MMR Random Fix
description: Fix some bugs in Modular Machinery Reborn mod.
body:
# Multiblock Random Fix
This mod fixes two critical issues in Modular Machinery Reborn mod's multiblock preview interface:

1. Resolves "Accessing LegacyRandomSource from multiple threads" error that crashed preview interface.

2. Removes the stack limit of 64 items, allowing required items to be displayed correctly.

Now you can browse multiblock preview interfaces without crashes or missing materials.
